purpose: Qualify one headed SGDN-2 residual memory insertion with distinct writes, functional multi-chunk training, delayed use after context removal, linear/full-context/zero/shuffled/disabled controls, correction, restart and retention. Small diagnostic, not a general memory claim.
parent_role: E2 extension initialization and regression reference; SGDN-2 write/read parameters are fresh.

training.feature_producer: frozen native input-token embeddings of observed source pages; generated answers and future observations excluded
training.write_schedule: two observed source pages -> two deferred functional commits; query/action never enters the write
training.loss: response-only next-token cross entropy on answer plus EOS; prompt prefix masked
training.selection: empty record bank; only committed fast state supplies observations
training.retention_replay: two fixed retention cases evaluated before and after candidate training

evaluation.metric: exact stripped answer; raw generated token IDs and answers retained
evaluation.correction: apply each correction and require changed state and changed answer where appropriate
evaluation.restart: persist the first held-out image, reload it and compare generated answer/state digest

decision_rule.accept: correct held-out exact accuracy strictly above linear, shuffled, zero and disabled, with dev not below disabled
decision_rule.reject: no positive held-out gain or dev regression
decision_rule.no_promotion: even an accepted small diagnostic is opt-in only

stop_conditions: future/source text appears in the write
retention: Keep parent extension, candidate extension, raw prompts/answers, persisted fast image and failure evidence. No base copy or download.
claims: One headed SGDN-2 delayed-use diagnostic on fresh synthetic pages; no general memory, reasoning, self-improvement or personal-fidelity claim.
